data.content_ref: inline:Extend the grounded extension to a credal semantics: each node carries a probability interval [lo, hi] rather than a Boolean label, and the fixed point is the least fixed point of a monotone operator on a finite lattice of intervals, with acceptance defined as lo > τ for a rational threshold τ. Determinism and polynomial cost hold if the operator is componentwise monotone and each update is arithmetic; but reinstatement becomes a derived inequality that can fail to be monotone across thresholds, and the interval semantics may admit multiple fixed points when the lattice is not a complete lattice, so the skeptical choice must be proven unique.
